Q4_parallel_pipeline.detail: sandbox/t47_sai_controlled_execution.py is a manually-invoked script, not hooked into CM v0.1 or the bridge_runner workflow. It correctly calls write_sai_output_to_outbox() (standard path), but the overall flow is: agent writes script → agent runs script → agent separately calls bridge_runner CLI — rather than: CM v0.1 picks goal → generates prompt → waits for outbox → bridge_runner auto-consumes. The governance components (gate, outbox adapter, bridge_runner) are all genuine. The orchestration layer (CM v0.1 driving it) is absent.
